role: Short-horizon crude-oil calendar-spread candidate with strategy-owned books, dedicated PM styles and a metadata-only market-history coordinate adapter that restores the market owner's already-visible named-contract weekly history.
invariants: the strategy identity remains crude_oil -> short_horizon -> relative_value_calendar_spread
the market-history adapter changes only missing weekly coordinate metadata by inheriting parent monthly year and month
the adapter never changes market prices, volume, open interest, participant limits, market identity, cutoff or write-back state
explicit weekly year or month values that conflict with the parent month are rejected rather than overwritten
the adapted view remains strategy-local and is never written back to oil_futures_overlay
the restored weekly history is the market owner's already-visible named-contract history and introduces no future data
calendar-spread signal history continues to use aligned weeks shared by the current main and immediately adjacent next-main contracts
the dedicated PM style layer remains oil_calendar_spread_research_v1 and construction capability remains oil_strategy_research_v2
strategy positions remain strategy-owned named-contract lots from oil_strategy_book_v1; aggregate account positions are not accepted as strategy state
target_main_lots plus target_next_main_lots always equals zero
construction cannot create or reverse a signal direction
paired execution hard limits, thesis maturity rules and PnL identities remain inherited from the existing calendar-spread primitives
the candidate remains outside OilInvestmentCompetitionSession until execution, settlement, portfolio-risk and economic-calibration gates are complete
